Schoology Teacher Admin Account Set up

✍️ Made by Jon F

→

In Schoology, manually create your 2nd account. Make sure to set that account as a Building Level System Admin

The second account will serve as your Admin account.

You should use your @apps email for this 2nd account.

1

Click Profile button in the top right

2

Click Settings

When you get this set up, you will see your second account shown in the drop down here, I blurred it for simplicity

3

Scroll down ad click the "Link Accounts" link

4

Enter the email used for your 2nd account.

This will ask you enter the email address used and the password that you just sent

5

Click the drop down to select your long form email as the Primary Email

6

Save Changes

7

When you log in, you will have to click the settings to switch to your manually created Admin Account

💡

Don't forget to give your new Admin Account to have all the needed Building access needed
